status: source-written private native leaf; no compilation, runtime or public environment acceptance
source_basis: Node v24.13.0 commit def0bdf8abee441cfcbf793a8dc24a6f3b899573; actual pinned Zig 0.16 libc++ native C++20 implementation
selected_allocation_basis: The old Zig StringHashMap draft is retained as map-zig-before-native-container.zig.txt. This successor instantiates the actual pinned libc++ basic_string and unordered_map templates with an empty allocator having the same propagation/equality properties as the default allocator.

Original MapKVStore C++ expressions are retained: find/contains construct their actual const-char String temporary; Set constructs RHS value then full-span key even on replacement; Delete constructs the full-span key; optional Get copy and the JS-facing second local copy remain distinct.

The original map's actual hash, bucket growth, element movement and iteration are executed by the same retained standard-container source. No guessed capacity charges, sorted keys, copied key snapshot or synthetic bucket order.

Every native allocation request uses the real unchanged pi_simd per-block aligned prefix and independently retains the native domain. AllocationScope is thread-local and synchronous. Every deallocation uses the original block owner, not the current scope.

Standard allocation retries the real native new_handler and uses the standard native bad_alloc/bad_array_new_length path. It never turns a native standard-container failure into an ordinary JavaScript reason. Translation units explicitly require exceptions disabled.

The stable Map object has one counted native lifetime, a real uv mutex, and the actual standard container. Lock guards retain before lock and unlock before release. The clone keeps the original no-added-lock copy contract.

The synchronous enumeration callback holds the actual mutex through native vector/string/array construction and retirement. Actual iterator initialization occurs on its first next after the caller's vector reservation.
explicit_dependencies: One shared native_simdjson_memory.cpp definition/TLS instance across parser and Map consumers; exact additive link proposal is still being prepared.
Actual native Environment State, supplied-map JS interceptors, Permission and physical cwd/execPath remain separate source units, not supplied by this leaf.
Source controls and native failure subprocess probes are not yet authored or executed.
This pins the admitted native libc++ implementation; it does not claim foreign stock Node libstdc++/MSVC binary allocation layout or iteration-order identity.
